text:
Hannah Park: Quick question for the roadmap meeting: customers want a per-tenant retention UI and legal hold history export for audits. Scope for MVP?

Jared Cole: MVP: API-only (apply/remove legal_hold) + CSV export of legal_hold events. UI can come later. Key requirement: every legal_hold event must include actor, timestamp, reason, and linked case id.

Nadia Gomez: Legal add: exported history must be tamper-evident. Include a signed snapshot (hash) at export time and store that hash in our audit ledger. Also require KMS key proof for BYOK tenants.

Isha Reddy: Engineering note: export size could be large; paginate and sign each page. Also add a retention metadata header with profile id and key fingerprint.

ComplianceBot: [system] Rule check passed for export format: includes required fields.

Hannah Park: Proposed minimal policy in RFC: 
- legal_hold API with justification and case_id
- exportable legal_hold history with signed pages
- admin role + 2FA required to remove legal_hold
- retention UI: postponed to Q4

Jared Cole: Also add a per-tenant default retention profile selector so PMs can set defaults at onboarding.

Nadia Gomez: Make removal a two-step process: 1) Legal request via UI or API, 2) Manual sign-off by Legal team member (automated if delegated). Both steps logged immutably.

Hannah Park: Ok - I'll add this to the roadmap as "Legal hold admin + history export" and work with Security to spec signing behavior. Assigning owners: Hannah->PM, Jared->API, Isha->export pagination, Nadia->legal runbook.

Isha Reddy: Noted. I'll prototype signed CSV page format and share in RFC.
